datasheet.revision_or_date: Hirose FH12 series catalog, Nov.1.2016 (PDF mod 2019-09-24)

contact_side: Bottom contact (catalog p.3/p.4 '0.5mm Pitch Bottom Contact Type'; JLC: '50P Bottom Contact'); panel spec asks for a bottom-contact ZIF -> the folded FPC's conductors face the PCB. Matches.
pin1: Catalog p.4 top view (tails up, FPC entering from below) shows the polarizing mark at the left end; it does not print contact numbers for the SH type. KiCad footprint pad 1 is at the left (x=-12.25) with tails at -y. Mapping check uses pad geometry (see PANEL.json fpc_orientation): J3 pin j = panel 51-j is correct.
